title: Deterministic Goldreich–Levin Learner
statement: Given a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input, define a deterministic query program that runs the Goldreich–Levin program and then, for each output state, runs the second-stage program on that state, returning a sparse Fourier hypothesis in the input dimension.
hypotheses_covered: The input's small-bias parameters have positive dimension and numerator, with twice the numerator at most the denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
caveat: The supplied statement omits definitions of the composed Goldreich–Levin program and its second-stage program.
